# PT Misuba Guna Indonesia

> PT Misuba Guna Indonesia is an Indonesian industrial engineering supplier and plant maintenance contractor. It supplies expansion joints, sealing systems, corrosion protection linings and coatings, couplings, thermal equipment and pulp & paper machinery, and provides on-site repair, lining and maintenance services to industrial plants across Indonesia.

Prices, stock and lead times are quoted per enquiry; none are published on the website.

## Company Overview
- **Legal Entity:** PT Misuba Guna Indonesia
- **Website:** https://misubaguna.com/
- **Sales Email:** sales@misubaguna.com

- **Billing Office:** Gedung STC Senayan Lantai 4 No 89, Jl. Asia Afrika Pintu IX, Gelora Senayan, Tanah Abang, Jakarta Pusat, Indonesia
- **Industries Served:** Power generation, petrochemical, chemical processing, pulp & paper, palm oil, mining, water treatment, food & beverage, heavy manufacturing.
- **Languages:** English, Indonesian

## Product Categories
- [Corrosion Protection](https://misubaguna.com/product-category/corrosion-protection/): Products and services for protecting industrial equipment against corrosion, abrasion, chemical attack, and severe operating conditions.
- [Coating](https://misubaguna.com/product-category/coating/): Ceramic coating and PTFE coating options for surface protection in industrial applications.
- [Sealing System](https://misubaguna.com/product-category/sealing-system/): Industrial sealing products including gland packing, oil seals, O-rings, gasket sheets, and mechanical seals.
- [Thermal Systems](https://misubaguna.com/product-category/thermal-systems/): Cooling towers, shell and tube and finned-coil heat exchangers, plate heat exchangers, oil coolers and water-cooled cartridges for industrial process, power and HVAC duty.
- [Paper & Pulp Machinery](https://misubaguna.com/product-category/paper-pulp-machinery/): Stock preparation systems, paper machines, tissue machines, molded fiber plants, refiner plates and screen baskets for paper mills.
- [Power Transfer](https://misubaguna.com/product-category/power-transfer/): Industrial power transfer and mechanical coupling solutions for pumps, gearboxes, motors, and rotating equipment.

## Products
- [PTFE Lining](https://misubaguna.com/product/ptfe-lining/): Advanced fluoropolymer PTFE lining solutions applied to pipes, fittings, vessels, and chemical columns to provide an impermeable, non-stick chemical barrier against aggressive acids and high temperatures.
- [Rubber Lining](https://misubaguna.com/product/rubber-lining/): Heavy-duty elastomeric rubber lining applications applied to tanks, pipes, slurry pumps, and process vessels for severe acid corrosion protection and coarse particle abrasion resistance.
- [Ceramic Lining](https://misubaguna.com/product/ceramic-lining/): High-density 92% and 95% Alumina ceramic tile lining systems for extreme abrasive wear, sliding friction, and erosion in mining, cement, coal, and bulk material handling.
- [FRP Lining](https://misubaguna.com/product/frp-lining/): Seamless glass-fiber reinforced plastic (FRP / GRP) composite lining systems applied on steel, concrete, and brick structures for heavy chemical, acid, and wastewater corrosion protection.
- [Ceramic Coating](https://misubaguna.com/product/ceramic-coating/): Advanced liquid ceramic polymer coatings and thermal spray ceramic barriers applied to metal components to prevent high-temperature oxidation, cavitation, erosion, and chemical corrosion.
- [PTFE Coating](https://misubaguna.com/product/ptfe-coating/): Precision industrial PTFE / Xylan fluoropolymer coating service applied to fasteners, valves, molds, and process components for non-stick release, low friction, and salt-spray corrosion protection.
- [Fabric Expansion Joint](https://misubaguna.com/product/fabric-expansion-joint/): Custom non-metallic fabric expansion joints designed by PT Misuba Guna Indonesia for high-temperature ductwork, boiler exhaust lines, and severe vibration isolation.
- [Metal Expansion Joint](https://misubaguna.com/product/metal-expansion-joint/): High-precision stainless steel and high-alloy bellows expansion joints engineered for thermal expansion compensation in high-pressure steam, oil, and gas piping.
- [Rubber Expansion Joint](https://misubaguna.com/product/rubber-expansion-joint/): Heavy-duty elastomeric rubber expansion joints designed to isolate pump vibration, absorb pipe movement, and compensate for misalignment in industrial water and fluid piping.
- [PTFE Expansion Joint](https://misubaguna.com/product/ptfe-expansion-joint/): Molded virgin PTFE expansion joints engineered for ultra-pure liquids, highly aggressive acids, solvents, and reactive chemical piping lines.
- [PTFE Lined Expansion Joint (Rubber and Metal)](https://misubaguna.com/product/ptfe-lined-rubber-metal-expansion-joint/): Hybrid expansion joints combining outer metal or rubber pressure strength with an internal continuous PTFE liner for severe chemical and high-pressure service.
- [Rubber Hose](https://misubaguna.com/product/rubber-hose/): Industrial-grade reinforced rubber hoses for safe, reliable transfer of water, oil, fuel, steam, food materials, and chemicals across manufacturing and mining sites.
- [Flexible Metal Hose](https://misubaguna.com/product/flexible-metal-hose/): Precision corrugated stainless steel flexible hose assemblies designed for severe thermal cycles, extreme high pressures, cryogenic media, and gas-tight fluid transfer.
- [High-Consistency Pulper](https://misubaguna.com/product/hicon-pulper/): Helical-rotor batch pulper running at 15–16% consistency, with the drum pulpers, dilution pulpers and reject-handling equipment that make up a complete waste paper pulping section.
- [Double Disc Refiner](https://misubaguna.com/product/disc-refiner/): Twin disc, conical and cylindrical refiners for controlled fiber development, with precise gap control and options for every furnish.
- [Screening & Cleaning System](https://misubaguna.com/product/screening-cleaning-system/): Cleaners, coarse and fine screens, reject handling and thickeners that remove contaminants and protect the paper machine.
- [Complete Paper Machine](https://misubaguna.com/product/paper-machine-line/): Turnkey paper machines from headbox to pope reel for kraft, board, writing, printing and specialty grades, up to 1,200 TPD and 1,200 m/min.
- [Tissue Machine](https://misubaguna.com/product/tissue-machine/): Crescent former tissue machines with Yankee dryer, hood and pope reel for facial tissue, toilet rolls, napkins and kitchen towels.
- [Molded Fiber Plant](https://misubaguna.com/product/molded-fiber-machine/): Automatic and robotic molded fiber forming machines, trimming, molds and prototyping, from single machines to turnkey plants.
- [Refiner Plates & Screen Baskets](https://misubaguna.com/product/refiner-discs-screen-baskets/): Replacement refiner fillings, plates and screen baskets for all major refiner and screen makes, built for long life and low energy use.
- [Chain & Grid Coupling](https://misubaguna.com/product/chain-grid-coupling/): Roller chain couplings for simple, tolerant low-speed drives and serpentine spring grid couplings for heavy torque with shock damping.
- [Coupling](https://misubaguna.com/product/coupling/): 60 coupling series in ten families, from miniature servo couplings to grid couplings for mill drives. Choose a family below, or send us the motor power, speed and shaft sizes and we will size it for you.
- [Disc Coupling](https://misubaguna.com/product/disc-coupling/): All-steel diaphragm couplings with stacked stainless disc packs: zero backlash, torsionally stiff and maintenance-free, rated to 280 °C.
- [Gear Coupling](https://misubaguna.com/product/gear-coupling/): Crowned-tooth gear couplings, from maintenance-free nylon-sleeve NL and TGL types to all-steel TGCL and GIICL drum gear couplings for heavy torque.
- [H-Block Elastic Coupling](https://misubaguna.com/product/h-block-coupling/): Flexible couplings that drive through separate H-shaped elastic blocks. Blocks change without moving the hubs; spacer and brake-disc versions are available.
- [Jaw Coupling](https://misubaguna.com/product/jaw-coupling/): Curved-jaw couplings with a polyurethane star spider, from compact L-type to heavy XL/GR clamp hubs. Interchangeable with the common GR, L, HRC and pump-coupling sizes.
- [Pin & Bush Coupling](https://misubaguna.com/product/pin-coupling/): Flanged couplings that drive through nylon pins or rubber-bushed pins: simple, rugged and repairable on site, for medium to very high torque.
- [Plum Blossom Coupling](https://misubaguna.com/product/plum-blossom-coupling/): Claw couplings that transmit torque through a multi-lobe polyurethane element: ML (GB/T 5272 LM) plum blossom couplings, NM multi-cam couplings and FALK-R housed couplings.
- [Rigid Coupling & Torque Limiter](https://misubaguna.com/product/rigid-coupling-torque-limiter/): JK clamp-shell rigid couplings, friction and ball-detent torque limiters that protect drives from overload, and the bell housings and brackets that mount pumps to motors.
- [Servo & Precision Coupling](https://misubaguna.com/product/servo-coupling/): Small, low-inertia aluminium couplings with clamp hubs for servo and stepper motors, encoders and ball screws. Zero-backlash disc, bellows and slit designs.
- [Tyre & Elastic Sleeve Coupling](https://misubaguna.com/product/tyre-coupling/): Highly flexible couplings with a rubber tyre, split urethane element or toothed elastomer sleeve. They take large misalignment and soak up shock and torsional vibration.
- [Gland Packing](https://misubaguna.com/product/gland-packing/): Our premium gland packing solutions provide dependable, low-friction sealing for rotating and reciprocating shafts. Available in diverse materials, they are engineered to minimize leakage and reduce equipment wear.
- [Oil Seal](https://misubaguna.com/product/oil-seal/): Designed to retain critical lubricants while excluding environmental contaminants, our radial oil seals ensure the smooth operation of rotating machinery. They are manufactured to strict tolerances for reliable, long-term performance.
- [O-Ring](https://misubaguna.com/product/o-ring/): Our comprehensive range of elastomer O-rings provides versatile, high-integrity sealing for both static and dynamic applications. They are available in precise formulations to meet specific pressure and media requirements.
- [Gasket Sheet](https://misubaguna.com/product/gasket-sheet/): Supplying versatile sealing for flanged connections, our gasket sheet materials are formulated to handle a wide spectrum of pressures, temperatures, and industrial media. They ensure a secure, leak-free joint in critical assemblies.
- [Mechanical Seal](https://misubaguna.com/product/mechanical-seal/): Engineered to provide advanced fluid containment, our mechanical seals minimize leakage and friction in rotating equipment. They are a highly efficient, low-maintenance upgrade for critical pumps and mixers.
- [Cooling Tower](https://misubaguna.com/product/cooling-tower/): Induced-draft counterflow and crossflow cooling towers in FRP, timber or concrete, sized to your heat load and wet-bulb conditions.
- [Heat Exchanger](https://misubaguna.com/product/heat-exchanger/): Shell and tube heat exchangers to TEMA standards and finned-coil air-cooled heat exchangers, built to your process duty.
- [Plate Heat Exchanger](https://misubaguna.com/product/plate-heat-exchanger/): Compact plate heat exchangers with high heat transfer per square metre, in gasketed, brazed and welded versions.
- [Oil Cooler](https://misubaguna.com/product/oil-cooler/): Shell and tube and air-cooled oil coolers for hydraulic, lubrication, gearbox and engine oil systems.
- [Water-Cooled Cartridge](https://misubaguna.com/product/water-cooled-cartridge/): Replaceable water-cooled tube bundle cartridges for oil coolers, compressor intercoolers and aftercoolers, and process coolers.

## Plant Maintenance & Engineering Services
- [Cooling Tower Repair & Refurbishment](https://misubaguna.com/services/cooling-tower-repair/): Comprehensive repair, thermal overhaul, fill replacement, structural waterproofing, and fan drive maintenance for industrial cooling towers.
- [Heat Exchanger Service & Repair](https://misubaguna.com/services/heat-exchanger-repair/): On-site and workshop repair services for shell & tube and plate heat exchangers including retubing, hydrostatic testing, and re-gasket service.
- [Thermal Spray Coating](https://misubaguna.com/services/thermal-spray-coating/): High-performance thermal spray coating and metal spraying solutions to restore worn components and protect against extreme abrasion, heat, and corrosion.
- [Rubber Lining](https://misubaguna.com/services/rubber-lining/): Workshop and field application of rubber lining sheets for tanks, vessels, pipes, and agitators to resist chemical attack and heavy abrasion.
- [FRP Lining & Repair](https://misubaguna.com/services/frp-lining-repair/): Fiberglass Reinforced Plastic (FRP) lining and structural relining for chemical tanks, scrubber ducts, trenches, and containment bunds.
- [PTFE Lining & Bonding](https://misubaguna.com/services/ptfe-lining-bonding/): Expert bonding and sleeve fitting of PTFE and PFA liners for piping, columns, valves, and ultra-pure chemical process equipment.
- [Expansion Joint Installation & Replacement](https://misubaguna.com/services/expansion-joint-installation/): Field installation, splicing, alignment, and emergency replacement services for metal, fabric, rubber, and PTFE expansion joints.
- [Mechanical Maintenance & Repair](https://misubaguna.com/services/mechanical-maintenance/): Preventive and corrective mechanical maintenance services for pumps, valves, rotating shafts, couplings, and mechanical seals.
- [On-Site Inspection & Troubleshooting](https://misubaguna.com/services/onsite-inspection/): On-site technical evaluation, root cause failure analysis, NDT inspection, and shutdown consultation for critical plant equipment.
- [Valve Repair & Overhaul](https://misubaguna.com/services/valve-repair/): Complete workshop and on-site repair, seat lapping, seal replacement, and pressure testing for control valves, safety valves, gate/globe valves, and actuators.
- [Gearbox Repair & Rebuilding](https://misubaguna.com/services/gearbox-repair/): Comprehensive overhaul and rebuilding of helical, planetary, worm, and bevel industrial gearboxes, including gear re-machining, shaft alignment, and seal replacement.
- [Pump & Rotating Equipment Repair](https://misubaguna.com/services/pump-repair/): Field and workshop repair of centrifugal, slurry, positive displacement, and vacuum pumps including dynamic impeller balancing and mechanical seal retrofitting.

## Engineering Toolkit (free tools)
- [Engineering Toolkit Hub](https://misubaguna.com/toolkit/): Free engineering utilities and technical reference tables.
- [Flange Dimensions & Standards](https://misubaguna.com/toolkit/flange-standards/): DIN, JIS (5K, 10K, 16K, 20K) and ASME B16.5 (Class 150-2500) pipe flange dimensions and bolt patterns.
- [Scientific & Engineering Calculator](https://misubaguna.com/toolkit/calculator/): Online engineering calculator with unit conversion and mathematical functions.
- [Material Property Library](https://misubaguna.com/toolkit/material-specs/): Searchable property database of industrial materials: steels, nickel alloys, elastomers, fluoropolymers, ceramics and gasket sheets.
- [Expansion Joint Selector](https://misubaguna.com/toolkit/expansion-joint-selector/): Pipe thermal expansion calculator (axial growth, anchor thrust) with rubber, PTFE, metal and fabric expansion joint recommendation.
- [Chemical Resistance Guide](https://misubaguna.com/toolkit/chemical-resistance/): Chemical compatibility chart for PTFE, EPDM, NBR, FKM (Viton), Neoprene, Hypalon, natural rubber, 316 stainless steel, ceramic and FRP against 40+ industrial chemicals.
- [EJMA Bellows Calculator](https://misubaguna.com/toolkit/ejma-bellows-calculator/): Online design check of metal bellows expansion joints (unreinforced, reinforced, toroidal) per EJMA Standards; results are reviewed by our engineering team.
